workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 位移量測預算練習：平面鏡外差干涉儀量 500 mm 平台，λ_vac = 632.99 nm，空氣 n = 1.000271，λ_air = 632.82 nm，條紋週期 λ_air/4 = 158.2 nm，全行程 3.16×10⁶ 個條紋，1024 細分給 0.154 nm 解析度。環境感測器不確定度 0.1 K、0.1 hPa、2 %RH，折射率不確定度 √(0.093² + 0.027² + 0.017²) ≈ 0.098 ppm，對 500 mm 為 49 nm；死程 50 mm 在 0.3 ppm 變化下 15 nm；Abbe 偏距 20 mm、俯仰 5 arcsec（24.2 µrad）給 485 nm；餘弦角 0.3 mrad 給 0.5×(0.3×10⁻³)²/2 = 22.5 nm；波長 1×10⁻⁸ 給 5 nm；非線性 0.8 nm。RSS ≈ 488 nm，k = 2 約 0.98 µm。若把 Abbe 偏距改到 2 mm，該項降為 48.5 nm，RSS 降到 ≈ 74 nm，k = 2 ≈ 0.15 µm，改善超過 6 倍，而干涉儀本身一項都沒變。數值為教學假設，不代表任何產品規格。
workedExample.textEn: Displacement-budget exercise: a plane-mirror heterodyne interferometer on a 500 mm stage, λ_vac = 632.99 nm, air n = 1.000271, λ_air = 632.82 nm, fringe period λ_air/4 = 158.2 nm, 3.16×10⁶ fringes over full travel, 1024 subdivisions giving 0.154 nm resolution. Sensor uncertainties of 0.1 K, 0.1 hPa and 2 %RH give an index uncertainty √(0.093² + 0.027² + 0.017²) ≈ 0.098 ppm, 49 nm over 500 mm; a 50 mm dead path under 0.3 ppm change gives 15 nm; a 20 mm Abbe offset with 5 arcsec (24.2 µrad) pitch gives 485 nm; a 0.3 mrad cosine angle gives 0.5×(0.3×10⁻³)²/2 = 22.5 nm; wavelength at 1×10⁻⁸ gives 5 nm; non-linearity 0.8 nm. RSS ≈ 488 nm, k = 2 about 0.98 µm. Reducing the Abbe offset to 2 mm drops that term to 48.5 nm, the RSS to ≈ 74 nm and k = 2 to ≈ 0.15 µm, a better than sixfold improvement without touching the interferometer itself. Values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「光程差、條紋與相位細分」與「外差偵測、都卜勒頻移與速度上限」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Optical-path difference, fringes and phase subdivision" and "Heterodyne detection, Doppler shift and the velocity limit": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 光程差、條紋與相位細分：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Optical-path difference, fringes and phase subdivision: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「量測臂、參考臂與相位計」如何決定雷射干涉位移量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Measurement arm, reference arm and phase meter” determines the key performance of “Laser-interferometric displacement metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雷射干涉儀把一道相干光分成參考臂與量測臂，量測臂的反射鏡隨待測物移動，兩臂重新合光後的干涉強度隨光程差作週期變化。角隅稜鏡干涉儀中位移 d 使光程差改變 2d，每移動 λ/2 走過一個條紋；平面鏡（雙程）干涉儀讓光束在量測鏡上反射兩次，光程差改變 4d，每 λ/4 一個條紋，對鏡面傾斜不敏感且解析度加倍。電子相位計把一個條紋再細分成數千等分，位移就是條紋數加上相位餘數乘以條紋週期，整個量測的長度單位來自雷射波長。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「量測臂、參考臂與相位計」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A laser interferometer splits one coherent beam into a reference arm and a measurement arm whose mirror moves with the target; after recombination the interference intensity varies periodically with the optical-path difference. In a retroreflector interferometer a displacement d changes the path by 2d, one fringe per λ/2; a plane-mirror (double-pass) interferometer reflects the beam twice from the measurement mirror, so the path changes by 4d, one fringe per λ/4, insensitive to mirror tilt and with doubled resolution. An electronic phase meter subdivides each fringe into thousands of parts, and displacement is fringe count plus phase remainder times fringe period, so the unit of length comes from the laser wavelength. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Measurement arm, reference arm and phase meter”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：雙程干涉儀相位 Δφ = 8πd/λ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Double-pass phase Δφ = 8πd/λ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平面鏡干涉儀每 λ/2 給一個條紋，和角隅稜鏡干涉儀一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A plane-mirror interferometer gives one fringe per λ/2 just like a retroreflector interferometer." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「量測臂、參考臂與相位計」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Measurement arm, reference arm and phase meter”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「光程差、條紋與相位細分」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Optical-path difference, fringes and phase subdivision" is correct?
options: 平面鏡干涉儀每 λ/2 給一個條紋，和角隅稜鏡干涉儀一樣。
雷射干涉儀把一道相干光分成參考臂與量測臂，量測臂的反射鏡隨待測物移動，兩臂重新合光後的干涉強度隨光程差作週期變化。
外差式干涉儀的解析度由分頻 f_s 決定，f_s 越高解析度越好。
optionsEn: A plane-mirror interferometer gives one fringe per λ/2 just like a retroreflector interferometer.
A laser interferometer splits one coherent beam into a reference arm and a measurement arm whose mirror moves with the target.
Heterodyne resolution is set by the split frequency f_s, so higher f_s means finer resolution.

quiz.explanationEn: A laser interferometer splits one coherent beam into a reference arm and a measurement arm whose mirror moves with the target; after recombination the interference intensity varies periodically with the optical-path difference. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 光程差、條紋與相位細分：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Optical-path difference, fringes and phase subdivision: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「量測臂、參考臂與相位計」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Measurement arm, reference arm and phase meter” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：雙程干涉儀相位 Δφ = 8πd/λ。穩頻 HeNe 真空波長 λ_vac = 632.99 nm，空氣中 n = 1.000271 時 λ_air = 632.82 nm，條紋週期 λ_air/4 = 158.2 nm；相位計細分 1024 等分時解析度 0.154 nm，4096 等分時 0.039 nm。量測 500 mm 行程要累計 0.5/158.2×10⁻⁹ ≈ 3.16×10⁶ 個條紋，計數電路一個條紋都不能漏。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Double-pass phase Δφ = 8πd/λ. A stabilised HeNe has vacuum wavelength λ_vac = 632.99 nm; in air with n = 1.000271, λ_air = 632.82 nm and the fringe period is λ_air/4 = 158.2 nm; subdividing 1024 ways gives 0.154 nm resolution and 4096 ways gives 0.039 nm. A 500 mm travel accumulates 0.5/158.2×10⁻⁹ ≈ 3.16×10⁶ fringes, and the counter may not miss a single one. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把量測鏡裝在壓電平台上，以已知電壓步進並用電容感測器或校正過的壓電係數對照，確認每 158.2 nm 剛好計到一個條紋、細分讀值在條紋內線性；再做往返行程，檢查歸零後的殘差是否小於一個細分單位，否則有漏計或相位計週期誤差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mount the measurement mirror on a piezo stage, step it with known voltages against a capacitance sensor or calibrated piezo coefficient, and confirm exactly one fringe per 158.2 nm with linear subdivision inside the fringe; then run a return trip and check that the residual after returning to zero is below one subdivision unit, otherwise fringes are lost or the phase meter has periodic error.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

quiz.question: 依「光程差、條紋與相位細分」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Optical-path difference, fringes and phase subdivision", which statement holds?
options: 週期性非線性是隨機雜訊，多次平均就能消除。
干涉儀解析度 0.1 nm，所以量測不確定度也在奈米等級。

steps.title: 光程差、條紋與相位細分：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Optical-path difference, fringes and phase subdivision: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「量測臂、參考臂與相位計」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Measurement arm, reference arm and phase meter” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把量測鏡裝在壓電平台上，以已知電壓步進並用電容感測器或校正過的壓電係數對照，確認每 158.2 nm 剛好計到一個條紋、細分讀值在條紋內線性；再做往返行程，檢查歸零後的殘差是否小於一個細分單位，否則有漏計或相位計週期誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mount the measurement mirror on a piezo stage, step it with known voltages against a capacitance sensor or calibrated piezo coefficient, and confirm exactly one fringe per 158.2 nm with linear subdivision inside the fringe; then run a return trip and check that the residual after returning to zero is below one subdivision unit, otherwise fringes are lost or the phase meter has periodic error. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：光束被遮斷或訊號強度瞬間低於門檻時計數器掉一個或多個條紋，之後所有讀值都偏移 158.2 nm 的整數倍且無法事後修正；在機台校正中這會表現為突然出現的台階狀誤差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A beam interruption or a momentary drop of signal strength below threshold makes the counter lose one or more fringes, after which every reading is offset by an integer multiple of 158.2 nm with no possibility of later correction; in machine calibration this appears as a sudden step in the error plot.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「光程差、條紋與相位細分」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Optical-path difference, fringes and phase subdivision"?
options: 把量測鏡裝在壓電平台上，以已知電壓步進並用電容感測器或校正過的壓電係數對照，確認每 158.2 nm 剛好計到一個條紋、細分讀值在條紋內線性。

steps.title: 光程差、條紋與相位細分：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Optical-path difference, fringes and phase subdivision: failure diagnosis

steps.title: 外差偵測、都卜勒頻移與速度上限：原理與系統邊界

steps.instruction: 外差式干涉儀的雷射輸出兩個頻率相差 f_s 的正交偏振分量，一個進參考臂、一個進量測臂；光電偵測器看到的是 f_s 的拍頻訊號，位移資訊藏在這個拍頻相對於參考拍頻的相位差中。鏡子移動時量測光束帶都卜勒頻移，拍頻變成 f_s ± 4v/λ；相位用交流訊號量測，對雷射強度漂移與偵測器偏壓不敏感，這是外差優於零差（直流）方案的關鍵。但拍頻不能降到零或翻轉，所以分頻 f_s 直接決定可量測的最高速度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雙頻雷射與都卜勒拍頻」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A heterodyne interferometer's laser emits two orthogonally polarised components separated by f_s; one goes to the reference arm, the other to the measurement arm, and the photodetector sees a beat at f_s whose phase relative to a reference beat carries the displacement. A moving mirror Doppler-shifts the measurement beam so the beat becomes f_s ± 4v/λ; because phase is read on an ac signal it is immune to laser-intensity drift and detector offset, the key advantage over homodyne (dc) schemes. The beat may not fall to zero or reverse, so the split frequency f_s directly sets the maximum measurable velocity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Two-frequency laser and Doppler beat”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：雙程干涉儀的都卜勒頻移為 4v/λ：v = 1 m/s 時 4/632.8×10⁻⁹ ≈ 6.32 MHz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Double-pass Doppler shift is 4v/λ: at v = 1 m/s it is 4/632.8×10⁻⁹ ≈ 6.32 MHz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外差式干涉儀的解析度由分頻 f_s 決定，f_s 越高解析度越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Heterodyne resolution is set by the split frequency f_s, so higher f_s means finer resolution." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 外差偵測、都卜勒頻移與速度上限：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙頻雷射與都卜勒拍頻」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Two-frequency laser and Doppler beat” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：雙程干涉儀的都卜勒頻移為 4v/λ：v = 1 m/s 時 4/632.8×10⁻⁹ ≈ 6.32 MHz。速度上限 v_max = f_s·λ/4：聲光調制分頻 f_s = 20 MHz 時 v_max ≈ 3.16 m/s；Zeeman 分頻 2 MHz 時只有 0.32 m/s。相位計若每 10 µs 更新一次，在 1 m/s 下每次更新之間移動 10 µm，約 63 個條紋，計數器必須以遠高於拍頻的時脈運作。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Double-pass Doppler shift is 4v/λ: at v = 1 m/s it is 4/632.8×10⁻⁹ ≈ 6.32 MHz. Velocity limit v_max = f_s·λ/4: with an acousto-optic split f_s = 20 MHz, v_max ≈ 3.16 m/s; a 2 MHz Zeeman split allows only 0.32 m/s. If the phase meter updates every 10 µs, at 1 m/s the mirror moves 10 µm between updates, about 63 fringes, so the counter clock must run far above the beat frequency. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用示波器或頻譜儀同時看參考拍頻與量測拍頻：靜止時兩者頻率相同，鏡子以定速移動時量測拍頻應偏移 4v/λ，由偏移量反算速度並與平台編碼器比較；逐步提高速度直到讀值跳動，確認失效點與 f_s·λ/4 一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Watch the reference and measurement beats together on an oscilloscope or spectrum analyser: at rest they coincide, and with the mirror moving at constant speed the measurement beat should shift by 4v/λ; back out velocity from the shift and compare with the stage encoder, then raise speed until readings break up and confirm the failure point matches f_s·λ/4.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.title: 波長穩定性、雙頻產生與溯源：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Wavelength stability, two-frequency generation and traceability: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「穩頻 HeNe 雷射頭」如何決定雷射干涉位移量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Frequency-stabilised HeNe laser head” determines the key performance of “Laser-interferometric displacement metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 位移的尺就是波長，所以雷射頭必須把頻率鎖住：常見作法是讓 HeNe 管內兩個正交偏振縱模的強度相等以鎖定腔長，或以 Zeeman 效應在軸向磁場中產生相差約 2 MHz 的左右旋圓偏振模態；需要更高速度時改用單頻雷射配聲光調制器移頻 20 MHz 以上。波長值由製造商對照碘穩頻 HeNe（CIPM 建議的 632.99 nm 參考）校正，商用雷射頭的波長準確度與長期穩定度通常在 10⁻⁸ 到 10⁻⁷ 量級，開機後需要數十分鐘熱平衡。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「穩頻 HeNe 雷射頭」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The ruler is the wavelength, so the laser head must lock its frequency: common schemes balance the intensities of two orthogonally polarised longitudinal modes of the HeNe tube to lock cavity length, or use the Zeeman effect in an axial magnetic field to create left- and right-circular modes about 2 MHz apart; for higher speeds a single-frequency laser is shifted by 20 MHz or more with an acousto-optic modulator. The wavelength value is calibrated by the manufacturer against an iodine-stabilised HeNe, the 632.99 nm reference recommended by the CIPM, and commercial heads reach wavelength accuracy and long-term stability of order 10⁻⁸ to 10⁻⁷ after tens of minutes of thermal settling. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Frequency-stabilised HeNe laser head”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：波長相對誤差直接變成長度相對誤差：Δλ/λ = 1×10⁻⁸ 時，1 m 行程的誤差為 10 nm，0.1 m 時 1 nm；若暖機不足使波長漂移 1×10⁻⁷，1 m 行程誤差升到 100 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Fractional wavelength error maps directly into fractional length error: at Δλ/λ = 1×10⁻⁸ a 1 m travel errs by 10 nm and 0.1 m by 1 nm; an under-warmed head drifting by 1×10⁻⁷ raises the 1 m error to 100 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「HeNe 雷射的波長是物理常數，任何 HeNe 都可以當作長度標準。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The HeNe wavelength is a physical constant, so any HeNe can serve as a length standard." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「穩頻 HeNe 雷射頭」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Frequency-stabilised HeNe laser head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 波長穩定性、雙頻產生與溯源：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wavelength stability, two-frequency generation and traceability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「穩頻 HeNe 雷射頭」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Frequency-stabilised HeNe laser head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：波長相對誤差直接變成長度相對誤差：Δλ/λ = 1×10⁻⁸ 時，1 m 行程的誤差為 10 nm，0.1 m 時 1 nm；若暖機不足使波長漂移 1×10⁻⁷，1 m 行程誤差升到 100 nm。相較之下 1 K 的空氣溫度誤差造成約 930 nm/m，所以波長穩定度在整體預算中通常只占小項，但它是整條溯源鏈的根。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Fractional wavelength error maps directly into fractional length error: at Δλ/λ = 1×10⁻⁸ a 1 m travel errs by 10 nm and 0.1 m by 1 nm; an under-warmed head drifting by 1×10⁻⁷ raises the 1 m error to 100 nm. By comparison a 1 K air-temperature error costs about 930 nm/m, so wavelength stability is usually a minor budget item, but it is the root of the whole traceability chain. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把雷射頭與碘穩頻參考雷射或經校正的波長計做拍頻比對，記錄開機後 0 到 60 分鐘的頻率漂移曲線，確定可用的暖機時間；每年或在懷疑漂移時重做並把波長值與不確定度寫進校正證書，溯源到國家計量機構的波長標準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Beat the head against an iodine-stabilised reference laser or a calibrated wavemeter, log the frequency drift from 0 to 60 minutes after switch-on to fix the usable warm-up time, repeat yearly or whenever drift is suspected, and record the wavelength value and uncertainty in the calibration certificate traceable to the national metrology institute's wavelength standard.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 波長穩定性、雙頻產生與溯源：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wavelength stability, two-frequency generation and traceability: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「穩頻 HeNe 雷射頭」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Frequency-stabilised HeNe laser head” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把雷射頭與碘穩頻參考雷射或經校正的波長計做拍頻比對，記錄開機後 0 到 60 分鐘的頻率漂移曲線，確定可用的暖機時間；每年或在懷疑漂移時重做並把波長值與不確定度寫進校正證書，溯源到國家計量機構的波長標準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Beat the head against an iodine-stabilised reference laser or a calibrated wavemeter, log the frequency drift from 0 to 60 minutes after switch-on to fix the usable warm-up time, repeat yearly or whenever drift is suspected, and record the wavelength value and uncertainty in the calibration certificate traceable to the national metrology institute's wavelength standard. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：雷射管老化使增益下降，穩頻迴路在兩模態強度無法平衡時跳到鄰近縱模，波長瞬間改變約 10⁻⁶，正在進行的長行程校正出現微米級台階且不可追溯。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: An ageing tube with falling gain lets the stabilisation loop, unable to balance the two mode intensities, hop to an adjacent longitudinal mode; the wavelength changes by about 10⁻⁶ at once and a long-travel calibration in progress acquires a micrometre step that cannot be traced.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 干涉光學元件與週期性非線性：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Interferometer optics and periodic non-linearity: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「偏振分光鏡、波片與平面鏡光學」如何決定雷射干涉位移量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Polarising beamsplitter, waveplates and plane-mirror optics” determines the key performance of “Laser-interferometric displacement metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 偏振分光鏡依偏振把兩個頻率分到參考臂與量測臂，四分之一波片讓每次往返的偏振旋轉 90°，使光束在平面鏡干涉儀中走完第二程後才離開；角隅稜鏡則靠三面正交反射把光原路送回。任何偏振洩漏——分光鏡消光比不足、波片相位誤差、鏡面應力雙折射或雷射兩頻率的偏振不正交——都會讓一部分參考頻率混進量測臂，拍頻相位出現隨位移週期變化的誤差，週期等於一個條紋，這就是外差干涉儀的週期性非線性，無法靠平均消除。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏振分光鏡、波片與平面鏡光學」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The polarising beamsplitter routes the two frequencies by polarisation into reference and measurement arms; quarter-wave plates rotate the polarisation by 90° on each round trip so that in a plane-mirror interferometer the beam leaves only after its second pass, while a corner cube returns the beam along its path through three orthogonal reflections. Any polarisation leakage, from limited beamsplitter extinction, waveplate retardance error, stress birefringence in the optics or imperfect orthogonality of the laser's two frequencies, mixes some reference frequency into the measurement arm; the beat phase then carries an error that cycles once per fringe with displacement, the periodic non-linearity of heterodyne interferometers, which averaging cannot remove. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Polarising beamsplitter, waveplates and plane-mirror optics”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一階週期性非線性的幅度約為 (λ/4)/(2π)·β，β 為洩漏場與主場的振幅比。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The first-order periodic non-linearity has amplitude about (λ/4)/(2π)·β, with β the amplitude ratio of leaked to main field.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「週期性非線性是隨機雜訊，多次平均就能消除。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 干涉光學元件與週期性非線性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Interferometer optics and periodic non-linearity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「偏振分光鏡、波片與平面鏡光學」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Polarising beamsplitter, waveplates and plane-mirror optics” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一階週期性非線性的幅度約為 (λ/4)/(2π)·β，β 為洩漏場與主場的振幅比。偏振分光鏡強度消光比 1:1000 時 β = √0.001 = 0.032，非線性幅度 ≈ 158.2/(2π)×0.032 ≈ 0.8 nm；消光比只有 1:100 時 β = 0.1，非線性升到 ≈ 2.5 nm，已超過許多奈米級平台的定位規格。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The first-order periodic non-linearity has amplitude about (λ/4)/(2π)·β, with β the amplitude ratio of leaked to main field. For a beamsplitter intensity extinction of 1:1000, β = √0.001 = 0.032 and the amplitude is ≈ 158.2/(2π)×0.032 ≈ 0.8 nm; at only 1:100, β = 0.1 and the non-linearity rises to ≈ 2.5 nm, beyond the positioning specification of many nanometre-class stages. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：讓量測鏡以壓電做慢速、平滑的掃描，同時以電容感測器量真實位移，把干涉儀讀值減去擬合直線後作頻譜分析，在每條紋一次與兩次的空間頻率處讀出非線性幅度；旋轉雷射頭或波片微調偏振對準，看幅度是否降到最低，並記錄最終值進入預算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Scan the measurement mirror slowly and smoothly with a piezo while a capacitance sensor records true displacement, subtract a fitted line from the interferometer reading and Fourier-analyse the residual, reading the non-linearity amplitude at once and twice per fringe; fine-rotate the laser head or waveplates to minimise it and record the final value in the budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.title: 空氣折射率、Edlén 公式與死程誤差：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Air refractive index, the Edlén equation and dead-path error: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「環境感測器與 Edlén 補償」如何決定雷射干涉位移量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Environmental sensors and Edlén compensation” determines the key performance of “Laser-interferometric displacement metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 干涉儀量的是空氣中的波長數，長度 = 條紋數×λ_vac/(4n)，因此空氣折射率 n 必須即時已知。n − 1 在標準狀態約 2.7×10⁻⁴，隨溫度、壓力、濕度與二氧化碳變化，Edlén 公式及其修正版（Birch–Downs、Bönsch–Potulski）或 Ciddor 公式用這些量算出 n，NIST 的工程計量工具箱提供公開的線上計算。死程是干涉儀歸零時量測鏡與分光鏡之間已存在的距離：歸零後若 n 改變，這段未被計數的光程也會跟著變，造成與位移無關的讀值偏移，必須以死程長度另外補償。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「環境感測器與 Edlén 補償」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The interferometer counts wavelengths in air, so length = fringes×λ_vac/(4n) and the air index n must be known in real time. At standard conditions n − 1 is about 2.7×10⁻⁴ and varies with temperature, pressure, humidity and carbon dioxide; the Edlén equation and its revisions (Birch–Downs, Bönsch–Potulski) or the Ciddor equation compute n from those quantities, and the NIST Engineering Metrology Toolbox offers a public online calculator. Dead path is the distance already present between beamsplitter and measurement mirror when the counter is zeroed: if n changes afterwards, that uncounted path changes too and produces a reading offset unrelated to displacement, which must be compensated separately from the dead-path length. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Environmental sensors and Edlén compensation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：近似靈敏度：∂n/∂T ≈ −0.93 ppm/K、∂n/∂P ≈ +0.27 ppm/hPa、∂n/∂RH ≈ −0.0085 ppm/%RH。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Approximate sensitivities: ∂n/∂T ≈ −0.93 ppm/K, ∂n/∂P ≈ +0.27 ppm/hPa, ∂n/∂RH ≈ −0.0085 ppm/%RH.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要實驗室溫控在 ±1 °C，干涉儀就不需要折射率補償。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With the laboratory held to ±1 °C the interferometer needs no index compensation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「環境感測器與 Edlén 補償」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Environmental sensors and Edlén compensation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：近似靈敏度：∂n/∂T ≈ −0.93 ppm/K、∂n/∂P ≈ +0.27 ppm/hPa、∂n/∂RH ≈ −0.0085 ppm/%RH。1 m 行程上，1 K 誤差 → 930 nm，1 hPa → 270 nm，10 %RH → 85 nm。感測器不確定度 0.1 K、0.1 hPa、2 %RH 時合成 √(93² + 27² + 17²) ≈ 98 nm/m ≈ 0.1 ppm。死程 100 mm 在歸零後溫度變 1 K（Δn ≈ 1 ppm）時產生 100 nm 偏移，即使平台完全沒動。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

A 100 mm dead path with a 1 K change after zeroing (Δn ≈ 1 ppm) produces a 100 nm offset even though the stage has not moved. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: Abbe 誤差、餘弦誤差與幾何誤差預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Abbe error, cosine error and the geometric error budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Abbe 偏距與光束對準」如何決定雷射干涉位移量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Abbe offset and beam alignment” determines the key performance of “Laser-interferometric displacement metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 干涉儀的光束就是量測線，Abbe 原則要求它與被測位移共線；若量測線與功能點之間有偏距 h，平台的俯仰或偏擺角 θ 會造成 h·θ 的一階誤差，而且不隨平台改善而消失。光束與運動軸之間的夾角 θ 則造成餘弦誤差 L(1 − cosθ) ≈ Lθ²/2，是二階但隨行程線性放大。平面鏡干涉儀還要加上量測鏡的平面度：平台側向移動時光束落在鏡面不同位置，鏡面起伏直接變成讀值。這些幾何項通常比干涉儀本身的解析度大兩到三個數量級，是預算的主體。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Abbe 偏距與光束對準」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The interferometer beam is the measuring line, and the Abbe principle requires it to be collinear with the displacement being measured; with an offset h between the measuring line and the functional point, stage pitch or yaw θ produces a first-order error h·θ that does not shrink as the stage improves. An angle θ between beam and motion axis gives the cosine error L(1 − cosθ) ≈ Lθ²/2, second order but growing linearly with travel. A plane-mirror interferometer adds mirror flatness: as the stage moves laterally the beam lands on different parts of the mirror and the surface figure enters the reading directly. These geometric terms are typically two to three orders larger than the interferometer's own resolution and dominate the budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Abbe offset and beam alignment”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Abbe 誤差 = h·θ：h = 50 mm、俯仰 10 arcsec = 48.5 µrad 時誤差 2.4 µm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Abbe error = h·θ: with h = 50 mm and 10 arcsec = 48.5 µrad of pitch the error is 2.4 µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「干涉儀解析度 0.1 nm，所以量測不確定度也在奈米等級。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With 0.1 nm resolution the measurement uncertainty is also at the nanometre level." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「Abbe 偏距與光束對準」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: Abbe 誤差、餘弦誤差與幾何誤差預算：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Abbe 偏距與光束對準」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Abbe offset and beam alignment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Abbe 誤差 = h·θ：h = 50 mm、俯仰 10 arcsec = 48.5 µrad 時誤差 2.4 µm。餘弦誤差 = Lθ²/2：L = 1 m、θ = 1 mrad 時 0.5 µm；對準到 0.1 mrad 則降為 5 nm。平面鏡平面度 λ/10 = 63 nm 的峰谷值在側向行程中直接出現在讀值裡。鋁製夾具 200 mm 在 0.5 K 溫差下伸長 23×10⁻⁶×0.2×0.5 = 2.3 µm，說明機械熱漂移同樣必須列入。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Abbe error = h·θ: with h = 50 mm and 10 arcsec = 48.5 µrad of pitch the error is 2.4 µm. Cosine error = Lθ²/2: at L = 1 m and θ = 1 mrad it is 0.5 µm, falling to 5 nm when aligned to 0.1 mrad. A plane mirror with λ/10 = 63 nm peak-to-valley flatness puts that figure directly into the reading during lateral travel. An aluminium fixture of 200 mm under a 0.5 K gradient grows by 23×10⁻⁶×0.2×0.5 = 2.3 µm, showing that mechanical thermal drift belongs in the same budget. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用自準直儀或電子水平儀量平台全行程的俯仰與偏擺，乘以實測的 Abbe 偏距得到誤差曲線；以光束走離法（在遠端用十字標靶觀察光斑位移）把餘弦角對準到 0.1 mrad 以下；平面鏡以干涉儀量平面度並在補償表中扣除；最後把干涉儀與另一條獨立量測線（例如第二台干涉儀或步距規）比較，殘差應在預算內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure stage pitch and yaw over the full travel with an autocollimator or electronic level and multiply by the measured Abbe offset to get the error curve; align the cosine angle below 0.1 mrad by beam walk-off, watching spot displacement on a far target; measure the plane mirror's flatness interferometrically and subtract it in the compensation map; finally compare the interferometer with an independent measuring line such as a second interferometer or a step gauge, and the residual should fit the budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.instruction: 在晶圓台或精密機台上，一支雷射頭透過分光器供應多條量測軸，每軸有自己的干涉儀、接收器與相位計，所有軸的資料必須在同一時刻取樣，否則平台在運動中各軸讀值對應不同位置。干涉儀訊號到控制器的延遲乘以速度就是位置錯誤，所以高速平台要求確定性的延遲與硬體觸發。光纖傳輸雷射雖然避免雷射頭的熱源靠近平台，但保偏光纖的偏振串擾會增加週期性非線性；光束在長行程上的走離、強度下降與空氣擾動也要在整合階段用擋風罩與短光路處理。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「多軸光路、延遲與同步觸發」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: On a wafer stage or precision machine one laser head feeds several measurement axes through beamsplitters, each with its own interferometer, receiver and phase meter, and all axes must be sampled at the same instant or a moving stage yields readings from different positions per axis. Signal latency from interferometer to controller times velocity is position error, so fast stages demand deterministic latency and hardware triggering. Fibre delivery keeps the laser's heat away from the stage but polarisation cross-talk in polarisation-maintaining fibre raises periodic non-linearity; beam walk-off over long travel, falling signal strength and air turbulence are handled at integration with shrouds and short paths. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Multi-axis optics, latency and synchronous trigger”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objective: 說明「步距規比對與不確定度預算表」如何決定雷射干涉位移量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Step-gauge comparison and uncertainty-budget table” determines the key performance of “Laser-interferometric displacement metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 整合後的驗證不是再量一次解析度，而是把整條鏈與獨立的、溯源到國家標準的實體標準比對：以校正過的步距規或量塊組在全行程上做雙向重複量測，依 ISO 230-2 的方式分出系統誤差、反向差與重複性；另一種方法是反轉測試，把干涉儀與量測鏡對調位置，幾何誤差換號而干涉儀誤差不變，兩者可分離。所有量測不確定度依 GUM 列成預算表，包含波長、折射率、死程、Abbe、餘弦、非線性、解析度與實體標準本身的熱膨脹，交接文件還要寫明對準程序、暖機時間與環境感測器位置。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「步距規比對與不確定度預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Post-integration validation does not re-measure resolution; it compares the whole chain with an independent physical standard traceable to the national institute: a calibrated step gauge or gauge-block set measured bidirectionally over full travel, separating systematic error, reversal error and repeatability in the manner of ISO 230-2. A reversal test, swapping interferometer and mirror positions so that geometric errors change sign while interferometer errors do not, separates the two. All uncertainties are tabulated per GUM, covering wavelength, air index, dead path, Abbe, cosine, non-linearity, resolution and the thermal expansion of the physical standard itself, and the handoff document states alignment procedure, warm-up time and sensor placement. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Step-gauge comparison and uncertainty-budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：500 mm 行程的預算（教學假設，皆為標準不確定度）：波長 1×10⁻⁸×0.5 m = 5 nm；折射率補償 0.1 ppm → 50 nm；死程 50 mm×0.3 ppm = 15 nm；Abbe 20 mm×5 arcsec = 485 nm；餘弦 0.3 mrad → 22.5 nm；非線性 0.8 nm；解析度 0.15 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Budget for 500 mm travel (teaching assumptions, all standard uncertainties): wavelength 1×10⁻⁸×0.5 m = 5 nm; index compensation 0.1 ppm → 50 nm; dead path 50 mm×0.3 ppm = 15 nm; Abbe 20 mm×5 arcsec = 485 nm; cosine 0.3 mrad → 22.5 nm; non-linearity 0.8 nm; resolution 0.15 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「干涉儀直接溯源到波長，所以不需要再和實體標準比對。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An interferometer is traceable to the wavelength, so comparison with a physical standard is unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「步距規比對與不確定度預算表」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 溯源驗證、比對測試與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Traceability validation, comparison tests and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「步距規比對與不確定度預算表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Step-gauge comparison and uncertainty-budget table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：500 mm 行程的預算（教學假設，皆為標準不確定度）：波長 1×10⁻⁸×0.5 m = 5 nm；折射率補償 0.1 ppm → 50 nm；死程 50 mm×0.3 ppm = 15 nm；Abbe 20 mm×5 arcsec = 485 nm；餘弦 0.3 mrad → 22.5 nm；非線性 0.8 nm；解析度 0.15 nm。RSS = 488 nm，k = 2 擴展不確定度 ≈ 0.98 µm，其中 Abbe 一項占 99%。鋼製步距規 500 mm、溫度不確定度 0.1 K 又貢獻 11.5 ppm/K×0.5×0.1 = 575 nm，比對時必須量工件溫度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Budget for 500 mm travel (teaching assumptions, all standard uncertainties): wavelength 1×10⁻⁸×0.5 m = 5 nm; index compensation 0.1 ppm → 50 nm; dead path 50 mm×0.3 ppm = 15 nm; Abbe 20 mm×5 arcsec = 485 nm; cosine 0.3 mrad → 22.5 nm; non-linearity 0.8 nm; resolution 0.15 nm. RSS = 488 nm, expanded uncertainty at k = 2 ≈ 0.98 µm, with the Abbe term taking 99%. A 500 mm steel step gauge with 0.1 K temperature uncertainty adds 11.5 ppm/K×0.5×0.1 = 575 nm, so the artefact temperature must be measured during comparison. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在全行程取至少 10 個目標位置、每位置雙向各 5 次，計算每點的平均偏差與標準差，與步距規證書值相減後畫出誤差曲線；若曲線斜率對應的 ppm 值超過折射率預算，先懷疑溫度感測；做反轉測試分離幾何項；最後確認每一項實測值都落在預算表內，簽署交接。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Take at least 10 target positions over full travel with 5 bidirectional repeats each, compute mean deviation and standard deviation per point, subtract the step-gauge certificate values and plot the error curve; if the curve's slope in ppm exceeds the index budget, suspect temperature sensing first; run the reversal test to separate geometric terms; finally confirm every measured term lies within the budget table and sign the handoff.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

quiz.question: 依「溯源驗證、比對測試與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Traceability validation, comparison tests and engineering handoff", which statement holds?
options: 500 mm 行程的預算（教學假設，皆為標準不確定度）：波長 1×10⁻⁸×0.5 m = 5 nm。
HeNe 雷射的波長是物理常數，任何 HeNe 都可以當作長度標準。
只要實驗室溫控在 ±1 °C，干涉儀就不需要折射率補償。
optionsEn: Budget for 500 mm travel (teaching assumptions, all standard uncertainties): wavelength 1×10⁻⁸×0.5 m = 5 nm.
The HeNe wavelength is a physical constant, so any HeNe can serve as a length standard.
With the laboratory held to ±1 °C the interferometer needs no index compensation.
quiz.explanation: 500 mm 行程的預算（教學假設，皆為標準不確定度）：波長 1×10⁻⁸×0.5 m = 5 nm；折射率補償 0.1 ppm → 50 nm；死程 50 mm×0.3 ppm = 15 nm；Abbe 20 mm×5 arcsec = 485 nm；餘弦 0.3 mrad → 22.5 nm；非線性 0.8 nm；解析度 0.15 nm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Budget for 500 mm travel (teaching assumptions, all standard uncertainties): wavelength 1×10⁻⁸×0.5 m = 5 nm; index compensation 0.1 ppm → 50 nm; dead path 50 mm×0.3 ppm = 15 nm; Abbe 20 mm×5 arcsec = 485 nm; cosine 0.3 mrad → 22.5 nm; non-linearity 0.8 nm; resolution 0.15 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 溯源驗證、比對測試與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Traceability validation, comparison tests and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「步距規比對與不確定度預算表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Step-gauge comparison and uncertainty-budget table” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在全行程取至少 10 個目標位置、每位置雙向各 5 次，計算每點的平均偏差與標準差，與步距規證書值相減後畫出誤差曲線；若曲線斜率對應的 ppm 值超過折射率預算，先懷疑溫度感測；做反轉測試分離幾何項；最後確認每一項實測值都落在預算表內，簽署交接。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Take at least 10 target positions over full travel with 5 bidirectional repeats each, compute mean deviation and standard deviation per point, subtract the step-gauge certificate values and plot the error curve; if the curve's slope in ppm exceeds the index budget, suspect temperature sensing first; run the reversal test to separate geometric terms; finally confirm every measured term lies within the budget table and sign the handoff. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：交接時只給出「解析度 0.1 nm、準確度 0.5 ppm」而沒有預算表與對準程序，使用者把角隅稜鏡換到不同偏距的位置，Abbe 誤差翻倍而無人察覺，產品公差連續超差數週才追溯到量測系統。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A handoff that states only resolution 0.1 nm and accuracy 0.5 ppm without the budget table and alignment procedure lets the user move the retroreflector to a different offset; the Abbe error doubles unnoticed and product tolerances are violated for weeks before the measuring system is suspected.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在全行程取至少 10 個目標位置、每位置雙向各 5 次，計算每點的平均偏差與標準差，與步距規證書值相減後畫出誤差曲線；若曲線斜率對應的 ppm 值超過折射率預算，先懷疑溫度感測；做反轉測試分離幾何項；最後確認每一項實測值都落在預算表內，簽署交接。
knowledge.textEn: Take at least 10 target positions over full travel with 5 bidirectional repeats each, compute mean deviation and standard deviation per point, subtract the step-gauge certificate values and plot the error curve; if the curve's slope in ppm exceeds the index budget, suspect temperature sensing first; run the reversal test to separate geometric terms; finally confirm every measured term lies within the budget table and sign the handoff.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「溯源驗證、比對測試與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Traceability validation, comparison tests and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在全行程取至少 10 個目標位置、每位置雙向各 5 次，計算每點的平均偏差與標準差，與步距規證書值相減後畫出誤差曲線。
干涉儀解析度 0.1 nm，所以量測不確定度也在奈米等級。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Take at least 10 target positions over full travel with 5 bidirectional repeats each, compute mean deviation and standard deviation per point, subtract the step-gauge certificate values and plot the error curve.
With 0.1 nm resolution the measurement uncertainty is also at the nanometre level.
quiz.explanation: 在全行程取至少 10 個目標位置、每位置雙向各 5 次，計算每點的平均偏差與標準差，與步距規證書值相減後畫出誤差曲線；若曲線斜率對應的 ppm 值超過折射率預算，先懷疑溫度感測；做反轉測試分離幾何項；最後確認每一項實測值都落在預算表內，簽署交接。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Take at least 10 target positions over full travel with 5 bidirectional repeats each, compute mean deviation and standard deviation per point, subtract the step-gauge certificate values and plot the error curve; if the curve's slope in ppm exceeds the index budget, suspect temperature sensing first; run the reversal test to separate geometric terms; finally confirm every measured term lies within the budget table and sign the handoff. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 溯源驗證、比對測試與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Traceability validation, comparison tests and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「步距規比對與不確定度預算表」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Step-gauge comparison and uncertainty-budget table” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 交接時只給出「解析度 0.1 nm、準確度 0.5 ppm」而沒有預算表與對準程序，使用者把角隅稜鏡換到不同偏距的位置，Abbe 誤差翻倍而無人察覺，產品公差連續超差數週才追溯到量測系統。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A handoff that states only resolution 0.1 nm and accuracy 0.5 ppm without the budget table and alignment procedure lets the user move the retroreflector to a different offset; the Abbe error doubles unnoticed and product tolerances are violated for weeks before the measuring system is suspected. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：所有量測不確定度依 GUM 列成預算表，包含波長、折射率、死程、Abbe、餘弦、非線性、解析度與實體標準本身的熱膨脹，交接文件還要寫明對準程序、暖機時間與環境感測器位置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: All uncertainties are tabulated per GUM, covering wavelength, air index, dead path, Abbe, cosine, non-linearity, resolution and the thermal expansion of the physical standard itself, and the handoff document states alignment procedure, warm-up time and sensor placement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「干涉儀直接溯源到波長，所以不需要再和實體標準比對。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An interferometer is traceable to the wavelength, so comparison with a physical standard is unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 交接時只給出「解析度 0.1 nm、準確度 0.5 ppm」而沒有預算表與對準程序，使用者把角隅稜鏡換到不同偏距的位置，Abbe 誤差翻倍而無人察覺，產品公差連續超差數週才追溯到量測系統。
knowledge.textEn: A handoff that states only resolution 0.1 nm and accuracy 0.5 ppm without the budget table and alignment procedure lets the user move the retroreflector to a different offset; the Abbe error doubles unnoticed and product tolerances are violated for weeks before the measuring system is suspected.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「溯源驗證、比對測試與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Traceability validation, comparison tests and engineering handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
